name: cursor-curse-monitor-by-lorapok
description: Live Cursor usage dashboard — included quota, Auto/API meters, local insights, budget, billing cycle, and free-fallback model switching. A Lorapok Labs product. Also available on VS Code Marketplace, Firefox Add-ons, Chrome (zip), and GitHub Releases.

cursorCurseMonitor.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh usage data from the Cursor API.

cursorCurseMonitor.customBudgetLimit.description: Optional personal budget cap in USD (0 = use plan included limit only).

cursorCurseMonitor.autoApplyFallbackMode.description: When usage is at 100%, apply Composer 2.5 (Fast off) after Cursor/VS Code is fully quit (quit-then-write with WAL/SHM backup). Never writes while the editor is running.

cursorCurseMonitor.showStatusBar.description: Show usage percentage in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Included quota or USD budget percent (rounded).
Auto and API feature percents from Cursor (up to 2 decimal places).
Plan percent plus Auto and API percents.
cursorCurseMonitor.statusBarUsageSource.description: Which usage numbers to show in the status bar.

cursorCurseMonitor.warnAtPercent.description: Show a warning notification when usage reaches this percentage.

cursorCurseMonitor.anonymousUsageStats.description: Anonymous usage heartbeat. Sends a periodic ping with a random install ID, OS, and host editor (Cursor/VS Code) only. On by default. No paths, tokens, emails, or workspace names are sent.

cursorCurseMonitor.productNotices.description: Show Lorapok product notices inside Cursor (releases, features, recovery tips). Polls the public notice API a few times per day.

cursorCurseMonitor.productNoticeUrl.description: URL for remote product notices shown in the extension.

cursorCurseMonitor.subscribeUrl.description: URL used when you opt in to release update emails from the dashboard.

cursorCurseMonitor.siteConfigUrl.description: Mission Control public config URL (reindex policy, subscribe availability).

enumDescriptions: Follow Mission Control policy from GET /api/site-config (recommended).
Allow reindex from the dashboard while the editor is open (creates backups first).
Require Cursor/VS Code to be fully quit before reindexing (safest).
cursorCurseMonitor.reindexWritePolicy.description: Optional local override for reindex write policy.

enumDescriptions: Follow Mission Control policy from GET /api/site-config (recommended).
Allow reindex from the dashboard while the editor is open (creates backups first).
Require Cursor/VS Code to be fully quit before reindexing (safest).
cursorCurseMonitor.indexWritePolicy.description: Alias for cursorCurseMonitor.reindexWritePolicy (cursor index write policy override).

cursorCurseMonitor.securityScanEnabled.description: Scan workspace files for exposed credentials and show security alerts.

cursorCurseMonitor.scanOnSave.description: Scan files when saving for potential credentials.

cursorCurseMonitor.blockSaveOnSecret.description: Block saving files that contain detected credentials (warn-only when false).
